function.description: Returns a list of PnP network devices using filters such as state, onboarding state, device type, PID, IP, site, smart account, and virtual account. For device types, use these exact values: SWITCH, ROUTER, ACCESS_POINT (for APs), WIRELESS_CONTROLLER (for WLCs), MOBILITY_EXPRESS, EWC, SENSOR. For model/family fragments, use pid with wildcards (do not use exact pid unless the user gives a full model). Examples: 9200 -> pid=*9200*; AIR-AP -> pid=AIR-AP*; Cat9k -> pid in [C9200*, C9300*, C9350*, C9404R*, C9407R*, C9410R*, C9500*, C9606R*, C9610*, C9KV*]; Cat3k -> pid in [WS-C3560*, WS-C3650*, WS-C3850*]; IE-3k -> pid=IE-3?00*; ISR 4k -> pid in [ISR4321*, ISR4331*, ISR4351*, ISR4431*, ISR4451*, ISR4461*]; ASR 1k -> pid=ASR1???*. Map claimed requests to state=Planned. For site filters: use siteNameHierarchy directly, or if you need siteId, call api_getSites first. For claim-failed investigations, pair with api_getDeviceHistory(serialNumber). Strict prohibition: For runtime WLAN/SSID/controller detail queries that include serial number, do not call this API. Use get_device_details to resolve canonical networkDeviceId; if unresolved, ask for hostname or management IP. This API is only for explicit PnP onboarding, claim, or history workflows.
function.name: api_getPnPDeviceList_legacy

limit.description: Maximum number of records to fetch. If not provided, backend default is used.

offset.description: Number of records to skip. This PnP API uses 0-based offset specifically (not 1-based like many other Catalyst Center list APIs). Always start from offset 0 for the first page of results. Do not use offset 1 unless the user explicitly requests a later page.

onbState.description: PnP device onboarding state filter (for example Planned, Onboarding).

sort.description: Comma separated list of fields to sort on.

state.description: PnP device lifecycle state filter (for example Unclaimed, Planned, Provisioned, Error). For user wording 'claimed', use Planned.
